reason: RQ2 measures whether a refresh plan detects an out-of-band change to a managed object. hashicorp/random resources have no external object: the provider stores the drawn value in state and reads nothing back from any external system on refresh, so no out-of-band mutation exists for a refresh plan to detect. No resource in the provider is an equivalent of local_file for this arm, so the arm is not run rather than approximated.
